page.layout: One block of text: a single column of Syriac, set right to left, in the centre of the page, running from the top to about two-thirds down the page, with a short last line at the foot. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines. No margin notes, no running head, no catchword, no signature.
page.notes: The page is printed in Syriac (Serto script), which I can see is running text but cannot read letter by letter at this resolution. I have not guessed any words, so every line is marked illegible; the counts are estimates from the line lengths. The line breaks and the division into paragraphs follow the visible indentations and line ends, but these are approximate. The right edge of the scan truncates the lines, so the beginnings of the lines may be partly missing. A clearer scan, or a higher-resolution image of the right-hand edge, would allow a proper transcription. The page number 658 is printed at the top left of the text area.
